schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The cairn system device — top-level holder of ground_loop, harbor_master, and bus. Every device has a presence on the bus, and the system itself is a device.
why: Every device has a presence on the bus (Akien, 2026-08-11). The system itself is a device and answers its own mail. Without it the system's own infrastructure machines (ground_loop, harbor_master, bus) hang off nothing — no introspection surface, no mail delivery, no bus address.
falsifier: The cairn device stops fronting its machines on the bus, or a second top-level device absorbs one of its machines.
learns: It does not learn — its machines learn. The device is a holder.
